meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 当用户报 LazyCodex/Codex 的 bug,Claude 会复现、写失败测试、实施最小修复并附证据;对上游发 PR,对 LazyCodex 自身发带补丁的 issue,不改代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 LazyCodex/Codex 的 bug、贡献修复代码、为 bug 开 PR 等时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复 LazyCodex 的这个 bug。
say.note: Claude 会复现、修复并提交带补丁的 issue。

say.text: 给 openai/codex 的这个 bug 开 PR,包含复现和验证日志。
say.note: Claude 会从 fork 创建 PR,附上测试证据。

say.text: 为 LazyCodex 的缺陷贡献修复,生成 unified diff 补丁。
say.note: Claude 会生成补丁并创建修复 issue。

howto.what_en: LazyCodex/Codex bug: Claude reproduces, adds a failing test, smallest fix, before/after evidence. Upstream: fork PR. LazyCodex: verified-fix issue with patch, no repo edits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Help me fix this LazyCodex bug.
say_en.note: Claude reproduces, fixes, and files a patch-bearing issue.

say_en.text: Open a PR for this openai/codex bug with repro and verification logs.
say_en.note: Claude creates a fork PR with test evidence.

say_en.text: Contribute a fix for this LazyCodex defect as a unified diff.
say_en.note: Claude generates a patch and creates a verified-fix issue.
